text:
tara: Postmortem follow-up for KV eviction cascade. I sketched remediation owners + test/eval additions so this pattern is covered going forward. Please confirm owners and short ETAs. TL;DR: curated regression bank, nightly smoke/replay, weekly scoped chaos drill, CI gating + dashboards.
ryan: thanks. can you list owners and deliverables?
tara: owners: regression bank -> @meera; nightly replay/smoke -> @josh; weekly chaos drill orchestration -> @ryan + infra oncall. ETAs: bank 6bd, replay 3bd, drill plan 10bd.
meera: taking regression bank. will pull 22 edge cases from postmortem traces and add 30 synthesized variations. need s3 path for raw traces.
tara: s3://incidents/kv-evict/2026-03-22/traces.tar.gz. helper: python tools/trace_to_prompts.py --src s3://incidents/... --out tests/regressions/kv-evict.jsonl
josh: taking nightly replay. plan: k8s CronJob at 03:15 UTC hitting staging-router, concurrency=35, max_tokens=240, replay sampled original requests. will open helm PR and link the chart.
ryan: for the chaos drill I propose a narrow scope: simulate 30% KV node dropout for 20m with gradual ramp, monitor kv_miss_rate, fallback_invocations, and routing_fallback_latency. require 2h window and IR approval. ops-bot can you request 2026-04-15 09:00-11:00 UTC?
ops-bot: Window request submitted. IR approval required 48h before run. React with :white_check_mark: to approve.
meera: how will CI gating look? tara: add evals/regressions/kv-evict/ with a GH Action that runs the bank and fails PRs if similarity metric drops > 3% or median latency increases > 10%. will open PR for the workflow.
josh: will also add a staging dashboard tile for kv_miss_rate and fallback_rate. please create console ticket and link PR.
tara: action recap:
- meera: curate regression bank + upload + evals CI (6bd)
- josh: nightly replay CronJob + helm PR (3bd)
- ryan: chaos drill plan + IR window + rollback dry-run (10bd)
- tara: add CI gating PR + create console metrics ticket
tara: marking items as blockers if not started by EOD Tuesday. ping @here for visibility :eyes: 
meera: sample preview uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/regressions/kv-evict-preview.jsonl
josh: helm PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/helm/pulls/77
ryan: approved the proposed window :white_check_mark:. will draft the drill runbook.
